title: Confession and Letter
author: Rafael Almeida
blurb: Coral Yarrow, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
